name: Fluxskin — Annual Geneware Fashion Convergence
creator: Founded by designer collective Osmunda Vaszary-Chukwu & The Dermal Avant
description: Fluxskin is a four-day geneware fashion festival held in the Crown District's converted meatpacking halls, drawing designers, bioengineers, and living models whose bodies are the medium. Presentations range from subcutaneous chromatic patterning and bioluminescent dermal inlays to fully functional structural modifications — gills, secondary eyelids, heat-sensing pits — worn as aesthetic statements. Unlike corporate geneware showcases, Fluxskin explicitly platforms Shelf and Tier 2 designers alongside Spire-funded studios, creating a genuinely cross-tier exhibition floor that is as much political statement as runway.
medium: physical / live exhibition / neural feed broadcast (licensed and pirate streams both exist)
cultural_impact: Fluxskin has become the primary incubator for geneware aesthetics that later filter into mainstream corponation cosmetic lines, meaning Shelf designers frequently find their work commercialized without credit or compensation — a tension that defines the festival's ongoing internal politics.
controversy: The 2221 Fluxskin featured a presentation by the Clearskin-adjacent designer Hartmut Sobieski-Nwoye that was widely condemned as a provocation; counter-demonstrations outside the venue were significant, and three exhibitors withdrew their work in protest.
story_hooks: A Tier 2 geneware designer discovers their signature dermal pattern — developed over five years — has been quietly patented by a HelixCorp subsidiary and is now appearing in a licensed cosmetic line with no attribution or payment.

A model scheduled to close the main Fluxskin runway presentation has disappeared 48 hours before the show; the modifications they were wearing were experimental and unregistered, and someone very corporate wants them found quietly.

An investigative journalist embedded in Fluxskin realizes that one of the 'independent' Shelf design studios on the exhibition floor is actually a front for a corponation scouting operation harvesting biological IP.
